subject: Cloud buying playbook + stakeholder map (NovusHealth private offers)
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@novushealth.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Cloud buying playbook + stakeholder map (NovusHealth private offers)

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the conversation earlier. As promised, I am putting together a short stakeholder map and proposed buying playbook so your procurement and cloud teams can see the path to a private-offer purchase on AWS or GCP and what the billing flow looks like. The goal is to get a PO or formal commitment by 2026-12-15 so your team can be live on our dedicated runtime for the January pilot.

High-level proposal:
- Evaluation window: 2026-12-06 → 2027-01-05 (4 weeks) with a technical acceptance gate on week 3.
- Procurement steps: legal review (Novus procurement) → private-offer creation (AWS/GCP) → PO issuance → invoice routing (to Novus finance).
- Billing path options: Marketplace private offer (invoice via the cloud provider) OR direct invoice from Redwood (preferred for net-30).

I've attached a one-tab MAP spreadsheet that assigns owners and suggested target dates. Soojin (cc) will handle the security/compliance checklist and Marissa will support billing/finance questions.

Could you confirm who from your procurement team will own the legal review and whether Novus requires vendor onboarding forms (W-9 / vendor profile) ahead of a private offer? Also, if AWS private offer is the preferred path, let us know whether your AWS account admin needs the pricing sheet attached.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Exec | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0182

Attachment: 2026-12-02_REDWOOD_NOVUS_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet: MAP, milestones, owners)
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@novushealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@novushealth.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Cloud buying playbook + stakeholder map (NovusHealth private offers)

Kimberly —

Thanks for the clear summary and the MAP. Quick answers from procurement side:
- Legal review owner: Tom Reynolds (cc'd) will own the contract redline and SOC 2 attestation check.
- Vendor onboarding: yes, we use a vendor profile form + W-9; I can have our vendor-ops intake specialist start that this afternoon.
- Preferred billing path: Marketplace private offer on AWS is preferred because our cloud chargeback tool integrates with AWS invoices. That said, finance may accept a Redwood invoice if we provide net-30 terms and a PO reference.

Constraints: Our approval board meets 2026-12-14; to make the 12/15 PO target we need the private offer pricing and a signed mutual action plan into DocuSign by 2026-12-10. Is that feasible?

I will also schedule a short sync (30m) with Tom + our AWS admin on Monday 12/06 to walk through the private offer creation flow.

Best,
Samantha
Sr. Procurement Manager, NovusHealth
samantha.lee@novushealth.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@novushealth.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@novushealth.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 03 Dec 2026 08:27:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Cloud buying playbook + stakeholder map (NovusHealth private offers)

Thanks, Samantha — appreciate the timing constraints and the approval board date. We can hit DocuSign by 2026-12-10 if we lock the pricing and redlines quickly. Proposed next steps (I updated the MAP spreadsheet):

Action items (owners + dates):
- Redwood to share private-offer pricing sheet and AWS step-by-step (Kim) — due: 2026-12-03 EOD
- Novus to start vendor onboarding (Samantha) — due: 2026-12-06
- Legal redline pass (Tom) — due: 2026-12-08
- Redwood to issue final MAP + DocuSign packet (Kim & Soojin) — due: 2026-12-09
- Novus approval board & PO issuance — target: 2026-12-15

Notes on billing path: If Novus takes Marketplace private offer route on AWS, the invoice will show as a line item from AWS and Novus will pay AWS; AWS then settles with Redwood. That typically keeps your chargeback tooling happy. If you need Redwood invoicing for internal cost-center reasons we can do direct billing (RDW invoice) — Marissa will confirm internal ops for net-30.

I've attached a short 'terms' PDF with the standard private-offer clauses we expect (refund windows, data handling, SLA). Soojin — can you confirm whether our security appendix is acceptable or if we should send a SOC2 extract for Tom?

Thanks — I will upload the MAP to HubSpot and share the DocuSign link once legal is green.

Best,
Kimberly

Attachment: redwood-private-offer-terms.pdf (PDF: standard private offer terms)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@novushealth.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@novushealth.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Dec 2026 09:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Cloud buying playbook + stakeholder map (NovusHealth private offers)

Kim / Marissa —

Quick security/compliance note for the MAP: Novus asked for a short SOC 2 extract and a description of our VPC/private deployment isolation for the pilot. I have the SOC 2 summary ready and will send a redacted extract to Tom directly (separate email) by EOD today.

Marissa — pls confirm whether Redwood can accept AWS marketplace settlement while issuing Redwood invoices for professional services (if Novus needs a single vendor PO to cover infra + services). If not, we should include both invoice options in the DocuSign packet.

Also included below are two clarifying bullet points for the MAP spreadsheet (I updated the "acceptance" row):
- Tech acceptance requires: (1) 2 sample workloads passing latency SLO on our dedicated pool, (2) customer verification of data retention settings.
- Post-PO onboarding: we will schedule a 2-week ramp with our Solutions team.

Thanks —
Soojin
Security & Compliance (customer-facing) | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@novushealth.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@novushealth.com>, Alice Chen <alice.chen@cloudprocure.io>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 16:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Cloud buying playbook + stakeholder map (NovusHealth private offers)

Short update — good news: Tom's legal pass was lightweight and our redlines are accepted with 2 small edits (payment clause + liability cap). Tom confirmed vendor onboarding is in motion.

I generated the DocuSign packet this morning (MAP + final SOW + private-offer terms) and sent it to Samantha and Tom. DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?token=5a7b...

Next milestones:
- 2026-12-10: DocuSign executed (target)
- 2026-12-14: Approval board review (Novus)
- 2026-12-15: PO issued / private-offer acceptance

Marissa — please confirm whether Redwood should expect settlement via AWS invoice or invoice directly to Novus. If we don't hear back by EOD tomorrow we'll include both routes in the billing packet and capture Novus' preference in the PO reference.

Thanks everyone — big thanks to Soojin for the SOC extract and to Alice from CloudProcure for the quick walkthrough earlier.

Best,
Kimberly
Senior Account Exec | Redwood Inference
